ImportUserId.description: The numeric ID of the Umbraco backoffice user responsible for save and publish actions performed during imports.

LogResults.description: Whether results from Emply imports should be logged.

Feeds.description: The Emply job feeds to import into Umbraco.

ParentContentKey.description: The key of the Umbraco content item under which imported jobs should be created.

ContentTypeAlias.description: The alias of the Umbraco content type used when creating imported jobs.

Enabled.description: Whether automatic Emply imports are enabled.

Delay.description: The initial delay before the first scheduled import. An integer specifies the number of minutes. A string may be a .NET TimeSpan value (e.g. "00:05:00") or an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. "PT5M").

Interval.description: The interval between scheduled imports. An integer specifies the number of minutes. A string may be a .NET TimeSpan value (e.g. "01:00:00") or an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. "PT1H").
